name: zclass_world_get_pending_fog_color_rgb01
description: zClass_World::GetPendingFogColorRgb01 reads the pending fog RGB color through the world class data and returns 0.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450ba0 validates fastcall world in ecx, outRed in edx, outGreen and outBlue on the stack, direct reads of worldData color fields at offsets 0x14, 0x18, and 0x1c, return 0, and no callees.
The native smoke sets pending fog color and verifies GetPendingFogColorRgb01 returns all three stored values before ApplyPendingFogSettings consumes them.
